com.zynthec.zLoader.name: zLoader
com.zynthec.zLoader.subtitle: Independent SideStore fork for iPhone and iPad.
com.zynthec.zLoader.localizedDescription: Sideloading and manage apps, deveoloper profiles and much more in zynthec style.
com.zynthec.zLoader.versionDescription: Corrected local tunnel status: Wi-Fi-only automatic errors are rechecked through the actual device-service path. Pairing, startup, endpoint and missing-tunnel states are shown separately. A WireGuard receiver inside zLoader still depends on zLoader execution; use an independent local VPN for other apps.
